protocol.trigger: Ask one clarification for every unresolved question, including non-material details.
protocol.sequence: Ask exactly one unanswered question at a time. Record and resolve it before asking the next question.
protocol.completion: Maintain the outstanding-question queue until every question is answered or skipped. After each answer, re-evaluate every remaining question against current decisions; skip an invalid or inapplicable question with its reason, then ask the next valid unanswered question. Resume the workflow only when no applicable unanswered questions remain.
protocol.checkpoint: Persist question ID, evidence, impact, choices, recommendation, resume action, and answer-or-skip status before waiting.

interaction.choices: Offer two to five meaningful exclusive choices, each with a short example.
interaction.fallback: Render identical text choices only when the host lacks interactive controls.

protocol.resolution: Append the answer to decisions.md, update the affected artifact, then continue with one next action.
